steps.text: 旅人主動問族人：有什麼可以幫忙的？
steps.textEn: The traveller asks a Tao villager: is there anything I can help with?

lines.zh: 請問有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？
lines.en: Excuse me, is there anything I can help with?

lines.zh: 好啊，謝謝你主動問。先幫忙把田埂上的草拔一拔。
lines.en: Sure, thanks for asking. Start by pulling the weeds on the field bank.

lines.zh: 下次跟著家裡的人一起來田裡，再慢慢學。
lines.en: Next time, come to the field with the family and learn slowly.

toast: 旅人可以跟族人一起體驗潮間帶與水芋田了。
toastEn: The traveller can now join the Tao members at the tide flats and the taro fields.

hint.zh: 芋頭田那邊常有長輩在忙，問問看能不能幫忙吧。
hint.en: There are often elders busy at the taro fields. Ask if you can help.

text.coop: 雙人：旅人＋主要帶領的族人（男旅多為族男，女旅多為族女）
text.coopEn: Pair: Traveller + the leading Tao member (usually the Tao man for a male traveller, the Tao woman for a female traveller)
text.unlockEn: Traveller versions of I2 and R5

steps.text: 旅人請主人家的女性長輩讓他跟族人一起去田裡
steps.textEn: The traveller asks the host family's woman elder if they can go to the field with the Tao members

lines.zh: 今天可以讓我跟著一起去田裡嗎？我會照著做，不亂碰。
lines.en: May I come to the field with you today? I'll do as I'm told and won't touch anything.

lines.zh: 好啊。跟著家裡的人，人家做什麼你就看，叫你幫忙再動手。
lines.en: Sure. Stay with the family. Watch what they do, and only help when you're asked.

steps.text: 旅人跟著族人，在田埂上遞東西、拔雜草
steps.textEn: The traveller follows the Tao members, passing things and pulling weeds on the field bank

lines.zh: 原來田埂要這樣踩，才不會把水路踩壞。
lines.en: So this is how you step on a field bank without breaking the channel.

lines.zh: 田裡的事由主人家安排，旅人只幫忙被交代的部分。
lines.en: The host family decides the field work. The traveller only helps with what they're asked to.

steps.text: 回主人家，聽長輩怎麼說
steps.textEn: Go back to the host family and hear what the elder says

lines.zh: 你今天很認真，也懂得先問。家裡的人都看到了。
lines.en: You worked hard today, and you knew to ask first. The whole family noticed.

toast: 主人家開始放心讓旅人一起做事了。
toastEn: The host family now feels at ease letting the traveller help.

hint.zh: 旅人可以問主人家的女性長輩，能不能跟族人一起去田裡。
hint.en: The traveller can ask the host family's woman elder about going to the field with the Tao members.

steps.text: 旅人坐上主人家的涼亭，聽長輩說食物的故事
steps.textEn: The traveller sits on the host family's pavilion and hears the elder's food stories

lines.zh: 來，坐上來，鞋子脫在下面。今天說說吃飯的事。
lines.en: Come, sit up here. Leave your shoes down there. Today let's talk about meals.

lines.zh: 以前飛魚季的時候，煮飛魚的鍋子，跟煮別的魚的鍋子是分開的。
lines.en: In flying fish season, the pot for flying fish used to be kept apart from the pot for other fish.

lines.zh: 芋頭是女人在田裡顧的，飛魚是男人從海上帶回來的。一頓飯，是全家一起做出來的。
lines.en: Women look after the taro in the fields; men bring flying fish back from the sea. A meal is made by the whole family together.

lines.zh: 吃飯的時候，長輩先拿；客人等主人說「吃吧」，再動手。
lines.en: At meals, the elders take first. Guests wait until the host says "eat", then start.

lines.zh: 我會記住。謝謝您把我當成家裡的人。
lines.en: I'll remember. Thank you for treating me like family.

toast: 長輩把旅人當成家裡的朋友了。故事卡「吃飯的事」已寫進手札。
toastEn: The elder now sees the traveller as a friend of the family. Story card "About meals" was added to your notebook.

hint.zh: 主人家的長輩常在涼亭上休息，旅人可以去坐坐，聽聽以前吃飯的事。
hint.en: The host family's elder often rests on the pavilion. The traveller can go sit and hear about meals in the old days.

review: 飲食故事（煮飛魚的鍋子分開、長輩先取、等主人說「吃吧」）的說法請族人確認

name.zh: 非飛魚季：划現代獨木舟，看族男划拼板舟
name.en: Off-season: paddle a modern kayak and watch the Tao man paddle a plank boat

text.pre: 尊重值「受信任」且 T2；可提早接，救生衣來自 S3
text.preEn: Respect "Trusted" and T2; can be taken early, life jacket from S3
text.kindEn: Take early, needs an item + season

steps.text: 旅人和族男一起，請主人家長輩同意下海
steps.textEn: The traveller and the Tao man ask the host family elder's permission to go out on the water

lines.zh: 現在不是飛魚季，可以下海走走。拼板舟是族男划的，你不要上去。
lines.en: It's not flying fish season, so you can go out on the sea. The Tao man paddles the plank boat — don't get on it.

lines.zh: 你去租車行旁邊租一艘現代的獨木舟，穿好救生衣，跟在族男旁邊就好。
lines.en: Rent a modern kayak next to the scooter rental, put on a life jacket and just stay near the Tao man.

lines.zh: 好，我划我的獨木舟，不碰拼板舟。
lines.en: Okay, I'll paddle my kayak and won't touch the plank boat.

steps.text: 族男划自己家的拼板舟到港外，示範怎麼看浪
steps.textEn: The Tao man paddles his family's plank boat outside the harbour and shows how to read the waves

lines.zh: 槳要一起下水，船才不會晃。你看，浪從那邊來。
lines.en: Put the paddles in together so the boat doesn't rock. Look, the waves come from over there.

steps.text: 旅人划租來的現代獨木舟，跟在拼板舟旁邊
steps.textEn: The traveller paddles a rented modern kayak alongside the plank boat

lines.zh: 從海上看島，山好綠！我跟在旁邊，不靠太近。
lines.en: The island from the sea — the mountains are so green! I'll stay alongside, not too close.

lines.zh: 拼板舟只由族男划。旅人和族女下海時，用的是現代的獨木舟，也不一定跟著族男出海。
lines.en: Only the Tao man paddles the plank boat. When the traveller and the Tao woman go out, they use modern kayaks, and don't always go with the Tao man.

steps.textEn: Thank the elder back on shore

lines.zh: 平安回來就好。你懂得在旁邊看，不去碰船，這樣很好。
lines.en: As long as you're back safe. You knew to watch from the side and not touch the boat. That's good.

toast: 旅人從現代獨木舟上，看族男划拼板舟。
toastEn: From a modern kayak, the traveller watched the Tao man paddle a plank boat.

hint.zh: 非飛魚季時，旅人可以借救生衣、租一艘現代獨木舟，跟在族男的拼板舟旁邊。
hint.en: Outside flying fish season, the traveller can borrow a life jacket, rent a modern kayak and paddle alongside the Tao man's plank boat.

review: 旅人只划租來的現代獨木舟，不上拼板舟；非飛魚季由族男陪同的海上體驗是否恰當，請族人確認

name.en: Learn to be invited to a meal

text.coopEn: Trio: whole party at the host family's house

steps.text: 全隊在主人家，等主人邀請一起吃飯
steps.textEn: The whole party waits at the host family's home to be invited to eat

lines.zh: 飯煮好了，大家進來坐。
lines.en: The food's ready. Everyone come in and sit.

lines.zh: （小聲）等長輩說「吃吧」，再開動。
lines.en: (quietly) Wait until the elder says "eat" before starting.

lines.zh: 好，我等一下。
lines.en: Okay, I'll wait.

lines.zh: 吃吧，不要客氣。
lines.en: Eat, eat — don't be shy.

steps.text: 飯後向主人家的女性長輩道謝
steps.textEn: Thank the host family's woman elder after the meal

lines.zh: 謝謝您，芋頭好香，魚也好好吃。
lines.en: Thank you. The taro was so fragrant, and the fish was delicious.

lines.zh: 你會等、會謝，以後常回來吃飯。
lines.en: You know to wait and to say thanks. Come back and eat with us often.

toastEn: Page "The Tao table" added to the field guide.

hint.zh: 主人家已經把旅人當朋友了。吃飯的時候，大家一起在家裡。
hint.en: The host family already sees the traveller as a friend. At mealtime, everyone is at home together.

review: 被邀請吃飯的禮節（等主人說「吃吧」、不自己夾遠處的菜）請族人確認

name.zh: 跟族男學結網（男旅版內容較多）
name.en: Learn net-knotting from the Tao man (more content for a male traveller)

steps.text: 旅人和族男一起，請椰油的長輩教結網
steps.textEn: The traveller and the Tao man ask the Yayo elder to teach net-knotting

lines.zh: 想學結網？要耐心，一個結一個結打，不能急。
lines.en: Want to learn net-knotting? You need patience. One knot at a time, no rushing.

lines.zh: 族男先打給你看，你照著做。
lines.en: The Tao man will tie one first for you to copy.

steps.text: 回主人家，旅人照著族男的手勢練習打結
steps.textEn: Back at the host family, the traveller practises knots following the Tao man's hands

lines.zh: 線繞過去，拉緊，再穿回來。
lines.en: Loop the thread over, pull tight, then thread it back.

lines.zh: ……好像歪了。再一次！
lines.en: …I think it's crooked. Again!

steps.text: 把練習的網片拿給長輩看
steps.textEn: Show the practice net to the elder

lines.zh: 結還鬆，不過會了。以後補網的時候，可以來幫忙。
lines.en: The knots are still loose, but you've got it. Next time we mend nets, you can come and help.

toast: 旅人學會了最基本的網結。
toastEn: The traveller learned the most basic net knot.

hint.zh: 椰油的長輩常在家門口補漁網，旅人可以和族男一起去請教。
hint.en: The Yayo elder often mends nets outside his door. The traveller and the Tao man can go learn from him.

review: 結網由誰教、旅人可以學到什麼程度，請族人確認

name.zh: 向租車行老闆借救生衣
name.en: Borrow a life jacket from the scooter rental owner

steps.text: 旅人向租車行老闆借救生衣
steps.textEn: The traveller borrows a life jacket from the scooter rental owner

lines.zh: 請問可以借救生衣嗎？
lines.en: Excuse me, could I borrow a life jacket?

lines.zh: 可以啊。下水一定要穿好，安全第一。
lines.en: Sure. Always wear it properly in the water. Safety first.

toast: 母雞岩浮潛（U1）與非飛魚季拼板舟體驗（V4）需要它。
toastEn: Needed for snorkelling at Hen Rock (U1) and the off-season plank boat experience (V4).

hint.zh: 救生衣可以跟租車行借。
hint.en: You can borrow a life jacket from the scooter rental.

name.zh: 聽部落文化工作者說明聖地與距離規矩
name.en: Hear the village culture worker explain sacred places and keeping your distance

text.coop: 雙人：旅人＋族人（NPC 文化工作者說明）
text.coopEn: Pair: Traveller + Tao member (NPC culture worker explains)
text.unlock: P05、P07、P18 可以遠拍；相簿照片的文化筆記欄；B3
text.unlockEn: P05, P07, P18 can be photographed from afar; culture notes in the album; B3

steps.text: 旅人和族人一起，聽部落文化工作者說明聖地與距離規矩
steps.textEn: The traveller and a Tao member hear the village culture worker explain sacred places and keeping your distance

lines.zh: 你們想去五孔洞、天池那些地方拍照？先聽我說。
lines.en: You want to photograph places like Five Holes Cave and the Heaven Lakes? Listen to me first.

lines.zh: 島上有些地方，族人敬重，也忌諱。有的跟過世的人有關，有的是祖先留下的規矩。
lines.en: Some places on the island are respected by the Tao people and also taboo. Some are linked to those who have passed away; some follow rules left by the ancestors.

lines.zh: 那些地方，遠遠地看、在路邊拍就好。不進去、不觸碰、不撿石頭，也不要在那裡大聲笑鬧。
lines.en: At those places, just look from afar and shoot from the road. Don't go in, don't touch, don't pick up stones, and don't laugh loudly there.

lines.zh: 我知道了。遊客問我的時候，我也會這樣說明。
lines.en: I understand. When tourists ask me, I'll explain it the same way.

lines.zh: 照片可以留著，但寫下你在哪裡拍、為什麼只遠拍。這就是你的文化筆記。
lines.en: You can keep the photos, but write down where you took them and why only from afar. That's your culture note.

toast: 五孔洞、小天池、大天池可以在外面遠拍；相簿加上「文化筆記」欄。
toastEn: Five Holes Cave and the Little and Big Heaven Lakes can be photographed from outside, from afar. The album now has a "Culture notes" space.

hint.zh: 想拍五孔洞或天池之前，先和族人一起去朗島，聽部落文化工作者說明。
hint.en: Before photographing Five Holes Cave or the Heaven Lakes, go to Iraraley with a Tao member and hear the village culture worker explain.

review: 聖地與距離規矩的說法（遠看、不進入、不觸碰、不撿東西、不大聲笑鬧）請族人確認

name.zh: 飛魚季前聽海岸限制說明
name.en: Hear about coastal limits before flying fish season

text.seasonEn: Before the local flying fish season begins
text.unlock: 飛魚季遠拍規則提示（P13、P21）、尊重值
text.unlockEn: Hints for photographing from afar in flying fish season (P13, P21), respect points

steps.text: 旅人聽部落文化工作者說明飛魚季的海岸限制
steps.textEn: The traveller hears the village culture worker explain the coastal limits in flying fish season

lines.zh: 飛魚季快到了。那段時間，部落的灘頭是出海的人的地方。
lines.en: Flying fish season is almost here. During that time, the village beaches belong to the people going to sea.

lines.zh: 訪客不進灘頭、不在部落前面的海下水，也不要對著船和出海的人拍照。
lines.en: Visitors don't go onto the beach, don't swim in the sea in front of the village, and don't photograph the boats or the people going out.

lines.zh: 想拍海，就到部落外面的路邊遠遠地拍。
lines.en: If you want photos of the sea, take them from the roadside outside the village.

lines.zh: 好，東清的日出、八代灣，我都在路邊拍。
lines.en: Okay. The Iranmeylek sunrise, Badai Bay — I'll shoot them all from the road.

toast: 拍東清灣日出、八代灣時，手札會提醒飛魚季的拍法。
toastEn: When you photograph the Dongqing Bay sunrise or Badai Bay, the notebook will remind you of the flying fish season rules.

hint.zh: 飛魚季開始前，再去聽部落文化工作者說說海岸的規矩。
hint.en: Before flying fish season begins, go hear the village culture worker talk about the coastal rules again.

review: 飛魚季時訪客在海岸的限制（不進灘頭、不在部落灘頭下水、不拍出海的人和船）請族人確認
